## Features

### <img src="docs/sites/youtube.svg" width="36" align="absmiddle" alt="" /> YouTube

Full-window theater, denser feeds, frosted player chrome, and quieter navigation.

#### Search

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Immersive search** | Smooth blur and zoom effect when focusing the search bar. | On |

#### Home feed

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Feed layout fix** | Restore a denser home feed grid and compact video cards. | On |
| **Hide filter chips** | Remove the category chip bar and header row on the home feed. | On |
| **Thumbnail hover** | Enlarge inline video previews after hovering a thumbnail. | Off |
| **Hide distractions** | Remove Shorts shelves, merch shelves, and legacy annotations. | Off |

#### Navigation

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Compact sidebar** | Icon-only guide sidebar with a cleaner, minimal layout. | On |
| **Hide side guide** | Completely remove YouTube's side navigation. | Off |
| **Clean side guide** | Hide Studio, Sports, Settings, and footer links from the guide. | Off |

#### Player

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Theater mode** | Full-window theater view with configurable comments panel. | On |
| **Player blur** | Frosted-glass blur on video player controls and menus. | On |
| **Disable ambient mode** | Remove YouTube's cinematic ambient glow behind the player. | Off |
| **Better captions** | Use a compact frosted caption panel with clearer text. | Off |
| **YouTube TV** | Polish the large-screen YouTube TV player and overlays. | Off |

#### Live & comments

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Overlay live chat** | Float live chat at the right edge while in theater mode. | Off |
| **Movable live chat** | Drag, resize, and adjust live chat opacity in theater mode. | Off |

### <img src="docs/sites/github.svg" width="36" align="absmiddle" alt="" /> GitHub

Immersive header search, glass surfaces, and hover-revealed sidebars.

#### Search

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Immersive search** | Blur and zoom the page when focusing the header search bar. | On |

#### Home feed

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Hover sidebars** | Hide the home-feed left and right sidebars until you hover them. | Off |

#### Navigation

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **No tab text** | Repository tabs show icons only; labels appear on hover. | On |
| **Repo sidebar hover** | Collapse the repository About sidebar until you hover it. | Off |
| **Hide footer** | Hide GitHub's page footer. | On |
| **Hide toolbar separator** | Remove the divider in the header actions toolbar. | On |

#### Appearance

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Glass effect** | Frosted-glass look on buttons, comments, editors, and cards. | On |
| **Softer borders** | Drop table borders and round file, tab, and header edges. | On |
| **Remove button borders** | Strip borders from secondary buttons, inputs, and the branch bar. | On |
| **Timeline badges** | Give issue and pull-request timeline icons a clearer glass background. | On |
| **Chip spacing** | Add breathing room around overview chips and the Copilot menu button. | On |

### <img src="docs/sites/google.svg" width="36" align="absmiddle" alt="" /> Google

Search-bar glass, immersive focus, and calmer results chrome. Gmail, Docs, and other Google apps are left alone.

#### Search

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Immersive search** | Blur and scale the results page when the search box is focused. | On |

#### Home feed

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Hover filter chips** | Hide the Images and search filter chip row until you hover it. | Off |

#### Appearance

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Glass search bar** | Inset glass on the search box and a softer AI Overview panel. | On |
| **Solid overlays** | Keep sports, dialog, and mini-search overlays readable. | On |
| **Softer chrome** | Drop extra search-bar shadows and hide the page footer. | On |

### <img src="docs/sites/duckduckgo.svg" width="36" align="absmiddle" alt="" /> DuckDuckGo

Frosted panels, immersive search, and a cleaner homepage.

#### Search

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Immersive search** | Blur and scale the page when the search box is focused. | On |
| **Immersive popups** | Blur the page behind menus and settings. | On |

#### Home feed

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Hide Learn more** | Remove the homepage features section and scroll prompt. | On |
| **Hide homepage hero** | Remove the homepage hero promo block. | Off |

#### Navigation

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Hide feedback** | Remove the Share Feedback control. | On |
| **Hide footer** | Hide DuckDuckGo's page footer. | On |

#### Appearance

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Glass surfaces** | Frosted panels on the search box, cards, menus, and modules. | On |
| **Smooth blur** | Ease the immersive blur in and out. | On |
| **Clean decorations** | Remove leftover nav and chat form overlays. | On |

## Install

1. Clone this repo
2. Open `chrome://extensions`
3. Enable **Developer mode**
4. **Load unpacked** → select the repo root
5. Reload any open YouTube, GitHub, Google Search, or DuckDuckGo tabs

## Popup

Settings are grouped by **site**. The active tab is detected automatically. Each site's mods sit in animated, collapsible categories such as **Search**, **Home feed**, **Navigation**, **Appearance**, **Player**, and **Live & comments**. Disruptive mods default to off.

### Theater subsettings

| Setting | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| **Auto-hide header** | Hide the top bar in theater mode, reveal on hover. |
| **Blur header** | Frosted-glass blur on the masthead, matching player controls. |
| **Hover comments** | Show comments in a slide-in panel when hovering the edge. |
| **Comments side** | Which edge the comments panel slides in from. |

### Feed layout subsettings

| Setting | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| **Videos per row** | How many videos appear horizontally in the home feed grid. |

## Dev

```bash
npm install          # playwright for e2e
npm test             # manifest, CSS compatibility, and wiring
npm run test:e2e     # popup UI, theater geometry, and YouTube injection
npm run readme       # regenerate this README from live feature metadata
```

## Structure

```
manifest.json          MV3 config
scripts/               background, content, popup, sites, and icon JavaScript
popup/                 dark settings panel markup and styles
icons/                 extension icon (SVG source + PNG sizes)
docs/                  README banner and site artwork
styles/                per-feature CSS modules
tests/                 node:test + playwright e2e
```

## Notes

- Chromium only (`:has()`, `scale`, `backdrop-filter` with `-webkit-` prefix)
- Movable live chat stores its position and opacity in `chrome.storage.local`
- Zen's browser-window transparency mods are intentionally excluded — Chromium cannot expose the browser chrome backdrop to page CSS
- Site DOM changes may break selectors — report issues on GitHub
- Settings sync via `chrome.storage.sync` under key `chroModsSettings`
